title: Kailey Rose Kemp crowned Miss Fit Philippines 2026
summary: Kailey Rose Kemp from Santa Rosa, Laguna, was crowned Miss Fit Philippines 2026 during the pageant’s grand coronation night in Quezon City on Tuesday, October 27.
